_about: Plateau State ministries, departments and agencies, for `npm run agencies:seed -- data/plateau-mdas.json`. Each entry carries the sources it was corroborated from. Only `agencies` is read by the seeder; `needsConfirmation` is deliberately NOT seeded.
_method: Assembled from publicly reachable sources on 2026-11-04. plateaustate.gov.ng and en.wikipedia.org do not resolve from the session this was built in, so the official MDA index and the approved-budget PDF (the authoritative enumeration) could not be read directly. Everything in `agencies` is corroborated by TWO OR MORE independent sources. Anything resting on a single source — in particular an unofficial mirror whose names are internally inconsistent — is in `needsConfirmation` instead, because each row becomes a tenant whose name the AI says to citizens.
_verifyAgainst: https://www.plateaustate.gov.ng/ — official MDA index (was unreachable; confirm every name here against it)
https://www.plateaustate.gov.ng/uploads/PLATEAU_STATE_2024_APPROVED_BUDGET.pdf — budgets enumerate every MDA by name and code
_nameVariants: Several bodies appear under more than one wording in the press (e.g. 'Budget and Economic Planning' vs 'Budget and Planning'; 'Lands and Survey' vs 'Lands, Survey and Town Planning'; 'Youth and Sports Development' vs 'Youth Development'). The longer, more specific form is used, and the alternatives are recorded per entry. Renaming an agency later is a decision about an existing tenant's records, so the seeder will never do it.
